dedupe_keys.name: position du trait de cote du littoral sableux aquitain en 2018

description: Position du trait de côte du littoral sableux aquitain en 2018 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. 2018 coastline from Pointe du Verdon to Cap Saint Martin (ex-Aquitaine sandy coast). The coastline on the sandy coast corresponds to the foot of a dune. This rib trait was determined by photo-interpretation of orthophotography 2018 (©IGN, OCA 2018), supported by LiDAR data acquired synchronously during orthophotography. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Position of the Aquitaine sandy coastline in 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gironde, littoral_oca, Landes, côte sableuse, Pyrénées-Atlantiques, 2018. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
